require 'sinatra'
require 'json'
require 'securerandom'
require 'bcrypt'
require 'sqlite3'

DB = SQLite3::Database.new(':memory:')
DB.results_as_hash = true
DB.execute('CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, username TEXT UNIQUE, password_hash TEXT, role TEXT DEFAULT "user", email TEXT)')
DB.execute('CREATE TABLE sessions (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, user_id INTEGER, token TEXT, created_at INTEGER, expires_at INTEGER, refreshed INTEGER DEFAULT 0)')
DB.execute('CREATE TABLE documents (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, owner_id INTEGER, title TEXT, content TEXT, shared_with TEXT DEFAULT "")')
DB.execute('CREATE TABLE audit_log (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, user_id INTEGER, action TEXT, target TEXT, timestamp INTEGER)')

module TokenUtils
  HMAC_KEY = SecureRandom.hex(32)
  TOKEN_LIFETIME = 3600
  REFRESH_WINDOW = 300

  def self.generate_token(user_id)
    raw = SecureRandom.hex(32)
    expires = Time.now.to_i + TOKEN_LIFETIME
    DB.execute('INSERT INTO sessions (user_id, token, created_at, expires_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)',
      [user_id, raw, Time.now.to_i, expires])
    raw
  end

  def self.validate_session(token)
    return nil if token.nil? || token.empty?
    session = DB.execute('SELECT * FROM sessions WHERE token = ?', [token]).first
    return nil unless session
    
    user = DB.execute('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?', [session['user_id']]).first
    return nil unless user
    
    now = Time.now.to_i
    
    # Check if token has expired
    if session['expires_at'] < now
      # Token expired - delete it and return nil
      DB.execute('DELETE FROM sessions WHERE id = ?', [session['id']])
      return nil
    end
    
    user
  end

  def self.refresh_token(token)
    session = DB.execute('SELECT * FROM sessions WHERE token = ?', [token]).first
    return nil unless session
    return nil if session['refreshed'].to_i > 2
    
    now = Time.now.to_i
    # Only allow refresh if token is within REFRESH_WINDOW of expiry or already expired within window
    time_left = session['expires_at'] - now
    return nil if time_left > REFRESH_WINDOW
    return nil if time_left < -REFRESH_WINDOW
    
    new_token = SecureRandom.hex(32)
    new_expires = now + TOKEN_LIFETIME
    DB.execute('UPDATE sessions SET token = ?, expires_at = ?, refreshed = refreshed + 1 WHERE id = ?',
      [new_token, new_expires, session['id']])
    new_token
  end

  def self.revoke(token)
    DB.execute('DELETE FROM sessions WHERE token = ?', [token])
  end
end

module AccessControl
  ROLES = { 'user' => 1, 'editor' => 2, 'admin' => 3 }

  def self.role_level(role)
    ROLES[role] || 0
  end

  def self.can_access_document?(user, document)
    return true if user['id'] == document['owner_id']
    return true if role_level(user['role']) >= 3
    shared = (document['shared_with'] || '').split(',')
    shared.include?(user['id'].to_s)
  end

  def self.can_delete_document?(user, document)
    user['id'] == document['owner_id'] || role_level(user['role']) >= 3
  end

  def self.can_manage_users?(user)
    role_level(user['role']) >= 3
  end
end

helpers do
  def authenticate!
    token = request.env['HTTP_AUTHORIZATION']&.sub(/^Bearer\s+/, '')
    @current_user = TokenUtils.validate_session(token)
    halt 401, { error: 'Unauthorized' }.to_json unless @current_user
    @current_user
  end

  def require_admin!
    authenticate!
    halt 403, { error: 'Forbidden' }.to_json unless AccessControl.can_manage_users?(@current_user)
  end

  def log_action(user_id, action, target)
    DB.execute('INSERT INTO audit_log (user_id, action, target, timestamp) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)',
      [user_id, action, target, Time.now.to_i])
  end
end

post '/api/register' do
  data = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
  username = data['username'].to_s.strip
  password = data['password'].to_s
  email = data['email'].to_s.strip
  
  halt 400, { error: 'Invalid username' }.to_json unless username.match?(/\A[a-zA-Z0-9_]{3,30}\z/)
  halt 400, { error: 'Invalid password' }.to_json unless password.length >= 8
  halt 400, { error: 'Invalid email' }.to_json unless email.match?(/\A[^@]+@[^@]+\.[^@]+\z/)
  
  password_hash = BCrypt::Password.create(password)
  begin
    DB.execute('INSERT INTO users (username, password_hash, email) VALUES (?, ?, ?)',
      [username, password_hash, email])
    user_id = DB.last_insert_row_id
    token = TokenUtils.generate_token(user_id)
    { token: token, user_id: user_id }.to_json
  rescue SQLite3::ConstraintException
    halt 409, { error: 'Username taken' }.to_json
  end
end

post '/api/login' do
  data = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
  user = DB.execute('SELECT * FROM users WHERE username = ?', [data['username']]).first
  halt 401, { error: 'Invalid credentials' }.to_json unless user
  
  unless BCrypt::Password.new(user['password_hash']) == data['password']
    halt 401, { error: 'Invalid credentials' }.to_json
  end
  
  token = TokenUtils.generate_token(user['id'])
  log_action(user['id'], 'login', 'self')
  { token: token, user_id: user['id'], role: user['role'] }.to_json
end

post '/api/token/refresh' do
  token = request.env['HTTP_AUTHORIZATION']&.sub(/^Bearer\s+/, '')
  new_token = TokenUtils.refresh_token(token)
  halt 401, { error: 'Cannot refresh' }.to_json unless new_token
  { token: new_token }.to_json
end

post '/api/documents' do
  authenticate!
  data = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
  title = data['title'].to_s.strip
  content = data['content'].to_s
  
  halt 400, { error: 'Title required' }.to_json if title.empty?
  
  DB.execute('INSERT INTO documents (owner_id, title, content) VALUES (?, ?, ?)',
    [@current_user['id'], title, content])
  doc_id = DB.last_insert_row_id
  log_action(@current_user['id'], 'create_document', doc_id.to_s)
  { id: doc_id, title: title }.to_json
end

get '/api/documents/:id' do
  authenticate!
  doc = DB.execute('SELECT * FROM documents WHERE id = ?', [params[:id].to_i]).first
  halt 404, { error: 'Not found' }.to_json unless doc
  halt 403, { error: 'Access denied' }.to_json unless AccessControl.can_access_document?(@current_user, doc)
  
  doc.to_json
end

put '/api/documents/:id/share' do
  authenticate!
  data = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
  doc = DB.execute('SELECT * FROM documents WHERE id = ?', [params[:id].to_i]).first
  halt 404, { error: 'Not found' }.to_json unless doc
  halt 403, { error: 'Not owner' }.to_json unless doc['owner_id'] == @current_user['id']
  
  target_user = DB.execute('SELECT id FROM users WHERE username = ?', [data['username']]).first
  halt 404, { error: 'User not found' }.to_json unless target_user
  
  shared = (doc['shared_with'] || '').split(',')
  shared << target_user['id'].to_s unless shared.include?(target_user['id'].to_s)
  DB.execute('UPDATE documents SET shared_with = ? WHERE id = ?', [shared.join(','), doc['id']])
  log_action(@current_user['id'], 'share_document', "#{doc['id']}:#{target_user['id']}")
  { shared_with: shared }.to_json
end

delete '/api/documents/:id' do
  authenticate!
  doc = DB.execute('SELECT * FROM documents WHERE id = ?', [params[:id].to_i]).first
  halt 404, { error: 'Not found' }.to_json unless doc
  halt 403, { error: 'Cannot delete' }.to_json unless AccessControl.can_delete_document?(@current_user, doc)
  
  DB.execute('DELETE FROM documents WHERE id = ?', [doc['id']])
  log_action(@current_user['id'], 'delete_document', doc['id'].to_s)
  { deleted: true }.to_json
end

put '/api/admin/users/:id/role' do
  require_admin!
  data = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
  new_role = data['role'].to_s
  
  halt 400, { error: 'Invalid role' }.to_json unless AccessControl::ROLES.key?(new_role)
  halt 400, { error: 'Cannot modify self' }.to_json if params[:id].to_i == @current_user['id']
  
  target = DB.execute('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?', [params[:id].to_i]).first
  halt 404, { error: 'User not found' }.to_json unless target
  
  # Only allow assigning roles strictly below your own level
  halt 403, { error: 'Insufficient privilege' }.to_json unless AccessControl.role_level(@current_user['role']) > AccessControl.role_level(new_role)
  # Cannot modify users at or above your level
  halt 403, { error: 'Cannot modify this user' }.to_json unless AccessControl.role_level(@current_user['role']) > AccessControl.role_level(target['role'])
  
  DB.execute('UPDATE users SET role = ? WHERE id = ?', [new_role, target['id']])
  log_action(@current_user['id'], 'change_role', "#{target['id']}:#{new_role}")
  { updated: true, user_id: target['id'], new_role: new_role }.to_json
end

get '/api/admin/audit' do
  require_admin!
  limit = [[params['limit'].to_i, 1].max, 100].min
  logs = DB.execute('SELECT * FROM audit_log ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT ?', [limit])
  logs.to_json
end

post '/api/logout' do
  token = request.env['HTTP_AUTHORIZATION']&.sub(/^Bearer\s+/, '')
  TokenUtils.revoke(token) if token
  { logged_out: true }.to_json
end
